## Apps & Tools

### ScrollBudget
A Safari extension that enforces a budget for short-form videos. I much prefer it over screen time limits and was encouraged to publish it after good feedback from friends.
<br>
[![Download on the App Store](https://developer.apple.com/assets/elements/badges/download-on-the-app-store.svg)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scrollbudget/id6755718753)
